title: 49ers’ Nick Bosa gets another brutal reality check after bold return prediction

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers’ Nick Bosa gets another brutal reality check after bold return prediction
sources.description: Bosa declared two weeks ago that he would "definitely" make it back for the 49ers' game against the Falcons. On Friday, Kyle Shanahan revealed that his star edge rusher's confidence had been misplaced.
